# criblio_system_info (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_system_info" "my_systeminfo" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `api_port` (Number) Port that the Cribl API is listening on.
- `app_platform_enabled` (Boolean) Consolidated App Platform enablement status. <code>true</code> only when all of the following are true: the workspace-level App Platform kill switch (<code>apps.enabled</code>) is on, the <code>feature-app-platform</code> feature flag is enabled, the node is running in leader (master) mode, and the license permits App Platform. When <code>false</code>, App Platform routes are not registered and the UI hides the Apps navigation. Acts as the single source of truth for the product UI and Cloud Portal.
- `build` (Map of String) Build metadata for the running Cribl instance.
- `conf` (Attributes) Summary of the Cribl configuration, with counts of Sources, Destinations, Pipelines, Routes, and Rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--conf))
- `config_path` (String) Filesystem path to the Cribl configuration directory.
- `cribl_security_enabled` (Boolean) Consolidated Cribl Detect enablement status. <code>true</code> only when the <code>feature-cribl-security</code> feature flag is enabled and <code>appPlatformEnabled</code> is also <code>true</code>, since Detect ships as an App Platform app. Acts as the single source of truth for the product UI and Cloud Portal navigation entries.
- `deployment` (Attributes) Deployment this instance is running in. Commercial on-prem is <code>{ type: 'on-prem' }</code>. Highside is <code>{ type: 'on-prem', cloud: 'aws-highside' }</code>. SaaS is <code>{ type: 'saas', cloud: 'aws', env: 'commercial' | 'fedramp' }</code>. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--deployment))
- `dist_mode` (String) Distribution mode of the Cribl instance.
- `env` (Map of String) <code>CRIBL_*</code> and other explicitly allowlisted environment variables from the Cribl process, with sensitive values redacted.
- `guid` (String) Globally unique identifier for the Cribl instance.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the machine running the Cribl instance.
- `insights_enabled` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, Cribl Insights is enabled.
- `install_path` (String) Filesystem path where Cribl is installed.
- `is_highside` (Boolean) Whether this instance runs in the Highside deployment mode.
- `license` (Attributes) License information for the Cribl instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--license))
- `limits` (Attributes) System resource limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--limits))
- `openssl` (Attributes) OpenSSL version and FIPS provider information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--openssl))
- `os` (Attributes) Operating system information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--os))
- `system_conf` (Attributes) System configuration settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--system_conf))
- `version` (String) Version of Cribl software currently running on the host. In some responses this may be omitted; use <code>BUILD.VERSION</code> for the build version.
- `worker_processes` (Number) Number of active Cribl Worker Processes.

<a id="nestedatt--items--conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.conf`

Read-Only:

- `conf_version` (String) Version of the current configuration.
- `inputs` (Number) Total number of Sources.
- `name` (String) Name of the current configuration profile.
- `outputs` (Number) Total number of Destinations.
- `pipelines` (Number) Total number of Pipelines.
- `routes` (Number) Total number of Routes.
- `rules` (Number) Total number of Rules.

<a id="nestedatt--items--deployment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.deployment`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud partition. Absent for commercial on-prem.
- `env` (String) SaaS environment. Present only when <code>type</code> is <code>saas</code>.
- `type` (String) Deployment kind.

<a id="nestedatt--items--license"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.license`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Legacy contact email on system info: JWT license email when present, otherwise the registration email. Prefer <code>registeredEmail</code> for the address from product registration.
- `is_registered` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, the license is registered.
- `is_splunk_app` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, Cribl is running as a Splunk app.
- `limits` (Attributes) License-based feature and resource limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--license--limits))
- `registered_email` (String) Email from product registration. Separate from the JWT license email used in license aggregation.
- `type` (String) License type.

<a id="nestedatt--items--license--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.license.limits`

Read-Only:

- `app_platform` (Integer) App Platform limit.
- `edge_groups` (Integer) Maximum number of Edge Fleets.
- `edge_procs` (Integer) Maximum number of Edge Processes.
- `external_secret_stores` (Integer) Maximum number of externally backed secret stores.
- `heavy_duty` (Integer) When disabled, resource optimizations, like not spawning certain services or limiting RAM, are applied.
- `kms` (Integer) Maximum number of Key Management Service (KMS) providers.
- `lakehouse` (Integer) Lakehouse limit.
- `lake_access_groups` (Integer) Maximum number of Cribl Lake access groups.
- `lake_ddss` (Integer) Cribl Lake Dynamic Data Self Storage (DDSS) limit.
- `lake_metrics` (Integer) Cribl Lake metrics limit.
- `lake_storage_locations` (Integer) Maximum number of Cribl Lake Storage Locations.
- `leader_resiliency` (Integer) Leader resiliency limit.
- `max_executors_per_search` (Integer) Maximum number of executors per search.
- `notifications` (Integer) Maximum number of Notifications.
- `outpost` (Integer) Cribl Outpost limit.
- `outpost_groups` (Integer) Maximum number of Cribl Outpost Groups.
- `persistent_queue` (Integer) Persistent queue limit.
- `projects` (Integer) Maximum number of Data Projects (Data Subscriptions).
- `rbac` (Integer) Maximum number of role-based access control (RBAC) users.
- `record_erasure` (Integer) Record erasure limit.
- `remote_auth` (Integer) Maximum number of remote authentication connections.
- `remote_git` (Integer) Maximum number of remote Git connections.
- `s3_bundle` (Integer) S3 bundle limit.
- `sds` (Integer) Sensitive data scanning (SDS) limit.
- `search_acceleration` (Integer) Dataset acceleration limit. NOTE: Dataset acceleration is deprecated.
- `search_groups` (Integer) Maximum number of Cribl Search Groups.
- `system_email` (Integer) System email limit.
- `worker_groups` (Integer) Maximum number of Worker Groups.
- `worker_group_boot_throttle` (Integer) Whether the Leader may throttle Worker Group and Fleet APIs that boot a group process when resources are insufficient.
- `worker_procs` (Integer) Maximum number of Worker Processes.

<a id="nestedatt--items--system_conf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.system_conf`

Read-Only:

- `install_type` (String) Installation type for the Cribl instance (for example, <code>standalone</code> or <code>splunk-app</code>).
- `restart` (String) Restart policy for the Cribl instance (for example, <code>api</code> to allow restart from the UI, or <code>false</code> to disable it).
- `upgrade` (String) Upgrade policy for the Cribl instance (for example, <code>api</code>, <code>auto</code>, or <code>false</code>).
